note: Security (sec) gloss pack for study mode, 2026-10-05, beta

Why I write this blog, and my rules.it: Why I write this blog, and the **security baseline** of my rules.
Why I write this blog, and my rules.mean: the minimum set of safety rules

I write this blog because I want new fri.it: I write this blog for new friends, like a **Single Sign-On (SSO)** to meeting.
I write this blog because I want new fri.mean: one login that works for many services

I want to meet friends, and people I can.it: I want to meet people worldwide, and the blog is an **Identity and Access Management (IAM)** introducing me when I am away.

Work: only general talk about an industr.it: Work: only general industry talk, with **anonymization** so no one is identified.
Work: only general talk about an industr.mean: removing details that identify a person

Life: failures and regrets too.it: Life, with failures and regrets too, shared with **least privilege**.
Life: failures and regrets too.mean: giving only the access that is really needed

Things I am grateful for.it: When I write what I am grateful for, I respect the other's **consent**.
Things I am grateful for.mean: a person agreeing to how their data is used

Showing off my happiness.it: Showing off my happiness goes on my **blocklist**.
Showing off my happiness.mean: a list of things that are banned

Posts just to get attention.it: Posts just for attention are like **spoofing**, so I do not write them.
Posts just to get attention.mean: pretending to be someone or something else

Romance (Pengesso does not do romance).it: No romance, because Pengesso does not do romance, and it is not on the **allowlist**.
Romance (Pengesso does not do romance).mean: a list of things that are permitted

The company I work for, and what I do at.it: I do not write about the company or my work, protecting its **privacy**.
The company I work for, and what I do at.mean: the right to keep personal information private

I will keep writing this way. I hope you.it: I will keep writing this way, in good **compliance**.
